verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere documents native tool-calling in its SDK: you register tools, and the SDK runs the call-and-execute loop and detects the tool format the model expects. A community reply also confirms the product does tool calling with small models. Nothing in the pack covers reasoning-parser support, and the OpenAI-compatible endpoint is not documented as accepting tool or reasoning parameters. missing for 10: reasoning-parser support, tool-calling documented on the serving API/OpenAI-compatible endpoint, independent hands-on corroboration of tool-call reliability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use native tool-calling and reasoning-parser support in my requests

citations.quote: Register a tool and the function that runs it. The SDK owns the call-and-execute loop and detects the format the model expects.
This is a known limitation with small LLMs (0.6B-1.2B) doing tool calling.
